question: In a certain code language, 'WODMF' is written as 'ZRDKD'. How will 'EIDMC' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘WODMF' is written as 'ZRDKD’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dace77fd8a55011609de63c5afc6bb2f6f8b736911234773e5a32c088dc30d1d.png] 

Similarly, for '**EIDMC**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a47928fc3d47daf4918ed7f1f3d1dcd361ab712c911e07ef944744c1aa3062e.png] 

So, 'EIDMC' will be written as '**HLDKA**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
